mapper.select: SELECT a.id,a.title,a.cover,a.summary,a.category_id AS categoryId,c.name AS categoryName, a.view_count AS viewCount,a.comment_count AS commentCount,a.like_count AS likeCount, a.type,a.is_top AS isTop,a.published_at AS publishedAt FROM t_article a LEFT JOIN t_category c ON c.id=a.category_id AND c.deleted=0 WHERE a.deleted=0 AND a.status=1 AND a.type=#{q.type} AND a.category_id=#{q.categoryId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_article_tag at WHERE at.article_id=a.id AND at.tag_id=#{q.tagId}) AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q.keyword},'%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q.keyword},'%')) ORDER BY IFNULL(a.is_top,0) DESC,a.published_at DESC,a.id DESC
